name: Banneret
text: A fighter who carries the town's banner into battle and gathers lesser fighters around it.

features.name: Rally to the Banner
features.text: Militia and hirelings near the Banneret fight like trained soldiers.

features.name: Standard Planted
features.text: Planting the banner on a captured site claims it for the town and keeps the fog from closing over it.

features.name: Colours Never Fall
features.text: While the banner stands, allies nearby do not rout, even when their leader falls.

name: Beast Warden
text: Rangers who watch the monster lairs around town and cull them before they grow too big.

features.name: Lair Count
features.text: Knows how much a known monster lair has grown since the last visit.

features.name: Cull the Brood
features.text: Raids on lairs kill the young as well, setting the lair's growth back by weeks.

features.name: Apex Hunter
features.text: Deals heavy bonus damage to monsters that have grown off-screen into elders.

name: Bone Scribe
text: Reliquarians who read the lives of the dead from their remains, and learn the secrets they carried.

features.name: Read the Bones
features.text: Remains found on expeditions reveal where the dead person last went, lifting fog along their path.

features.name: Grave Ward
features.text: Consecrates the town graveyard so the lich's magic cannot raise those buried there.

features.name: Last Words
features.text: Can ask a fallen hero one question about how they died and what killed them.

name: Circle of the Fogbound
text: Druids who walk in the mist the way fish swim in water. The fog hides them and tells them things.

features.name: Mist Walker
features.text: Moves through fogged regions unseen and reports back more accurate sightings than other scouts.

features.name: Breathe the Fog
features.text: Can summon a bank of mist around the party, letting them slip away from a losing fight.

features.name: Fog Speaks
features.text: Once per day, learns what large creature moved through a fogged region in the last few days.

name: Circle of the Orchard
text: Druids who tend the town's fields and groves and coax reagents out of tilled soil.

features.name: Green Thumb
features.text: Farm plots and herb gardens near her cottage grow faster and resist blight.

features.name: Reagent Grove
features.text: Can plant a grove that slowly yields bloodmoss and emberroot for the alchemists.

features.name: Thorn Hedge
features.text: Grows a living wall of thorns along the town's edge that slows raiders and heals itself.

name: College of the War Drum
text: Bards who march with the militia, beating time for spears and walls alike.

features.name: Marching Beat
features.text: Allies within earshot move faster and hold formation when charged.

features.name: Thunder on the Walls
features.text: During a siege, drumming from a tower slows enemy assault waves and rallies fleeing defenders.

features.name: Unbroken Rhythm
features.text: Allies near the drummer cannot be frightened and recover from stuns quickly.

name: College of Whispers and Ale
text: Tavern bards who trade songs for secrets. The best rumors in town come from their table.

features.name: Last Round
features.text: A night of their songs at a tavern draws out one rumor about a site under fog.

features.name: Loose Tongues
features.text: Can sniff out a cult agent on the council by the way they sing along, revealing infiltrators over time.

features.name: Ballad of the Town
features.text: A song of the town's deeds raises renown, draws recruits from distant towns and steadies morale during a siege.

name: Coven of Ash
text: Witches who learned their craft burning plague houses. Fire is their cure.

features.name: Cleansing Fire
features.text: Burning a plague house ends the outbreak in that district at the cost of the building.

features.name: Ash Mantle
features.text: Immune to fire; foes that strike her in melee are burned.

name: Coven of the Cauldron
text: Hedge witches whose kitchen is an alchemy shop. They find new recipes by tasting what they should not.

features.name: Taste Test
features.text: Can identify any reagent at once, and sometimes discovers a new recipe on the alchemy map.

features.name: Simmering Pot
features.text: Brews potions slowly overnight that come out a grade stronger.

features.name: Ghostcap Broth
features.text: A broth that lets drinkers see invisible and ethereal things for a day.

name: Cutpurse of the Market
text: Pickpockets who work market day, and who know every face that passes the stalls.

features.name: Light Fingers
features.text: Comes home from market days with stolen coin and the odd stolen letter.

features.name: Crowd Ghost
features.text: Vanishes into a crowd and cannot be caught by the watch while the market is open.

features.name: Pocket the Key
features.text: Can lift a cult agent's token or a smuggler's ledger, exposing them to the mayor.

name: Duelist of the Square
text: Swordsmen who settle feuds in the town square for coin and glory. Crowds gather when one draws.

features.name: Called Out
features.text: Can challenge a single enemy; while they fight one-on-one, the duelist parries more often.

features.name: Settle It Here
features.text: A public duel can end a guild feud or a tavern brawl without anyone being jailed.

features.name: Riposte Master
features.text: Every missed attack against the duelist earns a free counter-strike.

name: Gatekeeper
text: The Warden who keeps the keys. Nobody enters the town without being seen.

features.name: Toll and Tally
features.text: Caravans through her gate pay a little more toll and smuggle a lot less.

features.name: Shut the Gate
features.text: Can bar the gate instantly when raiders are sighted, buying time for the militia.

name: Guild Fixer
text: A rogue who works for whichever guild pays, and keeps a ledger of everyone's secrets.

features.name: Leverage
features.text: Once a season, can sway a council vote by calling in a favour.

features.name: Two Ledgers
features.text: The thieves' guild treats the town gently while the Fixer is on good terms with the mayor.

name: Hearthkeeper Domain
text: Priests of the home fire and the town square. Their temple is the tavern as often as the chapel.

features.name: Common Table
features.text: Feasts held at the temple raise the whole town's mood and settle brawls.

features.name: Sanctuary Hearth
features.text: Townsfolk sheltering in the temple during a siege cannot be harmed by fire or fear.

name: Hearthwatch Warden
text: Wardens who keep the peace inside the walls, walking the night streets with a lamp and a cudgel.

features.name: Night Patrol
features.text: Crime falls in districts she patrols, and thieves caught by her talk freely.

features.name: Know the Street
features.text: Notices strangers who stay too long, slowly revealing cult agents hiding in town.

features.name: Curfew
features.text: Can call a curfew that shuts down smuggling and cult meetings, at the cost of tavern income.

name: Ley Surveyor
text: Wizards who chart the ley lines under the frontier and tap them for the town's mage tower.

features.name: Dowsing Rod
features.text: Expeditions find ley crystals at sites on a ley line.

features.name: Tap the Line
features.text: While in town, powers one magical surveillance building at no upkeep.

name: Ley-Touched Bloodline
text: Sorcerers born on a ley line. Their power surges when they stand on one and flickers when they do not.

features.name: Line Sense
features.text: Feels nearby ley lines and leads expeditions to ley crystals.

features.name: Surge
features.text: On a ley line, regains sorcery points steadily and casts with extra power.

features.name: Living Conduit
features.text: Can charge the town's enchanting forge directly, letting it work without crystals for a day.

name: Militia Captain
text: A veteran who turns farmers into soldiers and keeps them alive.

features.name: Muster
features.text: Can call up the militia without a council decree once per season.

features.name: Shield Wall
features.text: Militia next to the Captain cannot be routed.

name: Oath of the Hearth
text: Paladins sworn to one town above all others. Far from home they falter; at its walls they are unbreakable.

features.name: Home Ground
features.text: Gains strength and armour while inside the town's walls, and less on long expeditions.

features.name: Aura of the Threshold
features.text: Townsfolk near the paladin during a raid cannot be carried off or frightened.

features.name: Last Wall
features.text: When the town would fall, the paladin can hold its heart alone for a full minute while the rest regroup.

name: Oath of the Pale Ledger
text: Paladins who keep a written list of the undead they have laid to rest and hunt the necromancers behind them.

features.name: Rest Them
features.text: Smites against undead deal extra radiant damage and stop them from rising again.

features.name: Aura of Warm Blood
features.text: Allies nearby resist necrotic damage and cannot be raised as undead if they fall.

features.name: Balance the Ledger
features.text: Gains a lasting blessing for every hundred undead destroyed, readying the town for the lich's siege.

name: Path of the Blood Oath
text: A barbarian sworn to hunt one warband to its last fighter. The Bloodtusk know her name and fear it.

features.name: Named Foe
features.text: Choose a faction; her rage lasts longer and hits harder against its members.

features.name: Trail of Blood
features.text: Always knows the direction of the nearest camp of her sworn faction, even under fog.

features.name: Warlord's Bane
features.text: Duels with an enemy warlord or champion end faster, and a victory scatters the whole warband.

name: Path of the Siegebreaker
text: Barbarians who answer a wall with their shoulders. They are first through a breach and last out of it.

features.name: Ram's Fury
features.text: While raging, deals heavy bonus damage to gates, palisades and siege engines.

features.name: Hold the Breach
features.text: Standing in a broken wall section, she counts as a barricade: raiders must cut her down before pouring through.

features.name: Topple the Tower
features.text: Once per siege, can bring down an enemy siege tower or war wagon in a single charge.

name: Quarantine Domain
text: Grim clerics of the plague gate. They decide who comes in, and they burn what cannot be saved.

features.name: Plague Sight
features.text: Can tell at a glance whether a caravan or traveller carries disease.

features.name: Sealed Ward
features.text: Declares a district quarantined; disease cannot spread out of it while the cleric tends it.

features.name: Purge
features.text: A long rite ends every disease in town, but each sick villager has a small chance to die of the cure.

name: Road Warden
text: Cartographers who keep the trade roads open and the caravans moving.

features.name: Safe Roads
features.text: Mapped roads the Road Warden patrols see fewer ambushes and more caravans.

features.name: Milestones
features.text: Builds waystones that let parties rest safely on the road.

name: Saboteur
text: Rogues who slip into enemy camps the night before battle and leave nothing working.

features.name: Cut the Ropes
features.text: Sneaking into a siege camp delays the enemy's engines and burns their supplies.

features.name: Powder Keg
features.text: Rigs an explosive trap that devastates the first enemy wave through a gate.

features.name: Spike the Well
features.text: Poisons a warband's water so the whole camp fights weakened for days.

name: School of Far Sight
text: Diviners who staff the town's scrying tower. Their eyes are the only live window past the fog.

features.name: Steady Gaze
features.text: Scrying sessions she leads last longer and cost less.

features.name: Watch the Party
features.text: Can follow one expedition live for a while, letting the mayor see their fight as it happens.

features.name: Glass Sentinel
features.text: Leaves an invisible magical eye watching a region, keeping its fog clear for days.

name: School of Wards
text: Wizards who engrave the town's walls with protective sigils, one stone at a time.

features.name: Sigil Stones
features.text: Can inscribe wall sections so they shrug off magic and burn undead who touch them.

features.name: Warding Lattice
features.text: Linked wards share damage, so a breach at one wall section weakens all of them a little instead.

features.name: Wardsalt Circle
features.text: With wardsalt from the alchemists, raises a circle that no summoned creature can cross for a whole siege.

name: Shard Binder
text: Reliquarians who fit relic fragments back together, and wear the pieces until they are whole.

features.name: Mosaic
features.text: Can wear up to three relic fragments at once, each granting a small power.

features.name: Make Whole
features.text: Joining matching fragments at the enchanting forge creates a full relic with a cheaper, faster rite.

features.name: Shatter Pulse
features.text: Can break a fragment in combat to release its power in one devastating burst.

name: Smuggler's Chart
text: Cartographers who know the routes that are not on any map, and sell them.

features.name: Hidden Ways
features.text: Parties can reach sites without crossing enemy territory, avoiding warband patrols.

features.name: Black Market Map
features.text: Can sell a map of enemy territory to the town, revealing it under fog for a season.

name: Stormborn Soul
text: Sorcerers marked by a lightning strike in childhood. Weather follows them, and so does trouble.

features.name: Static Skin
features.text: Melee attackers take lightning damage, and her lightning spells arc to a second foe.

features.name: Call the Squall
features.text: Can summon a storm over a battlefield that grounds flyers and soaks fire.

features.name: Eye of the Storm
features.text: Becomes a storm for a short time, flying and striking every foe nearby with lightning.

name: The Drowned Bell Patron
text: A warlock bound to something that rings beneath a sunken village. It wants the bells of every town.

features.name: Undertow
features.text: Spells drag foes toward the warlock and slow them as if wading.

features.name: Tolling Message
features.text: Can send short messages to any ally who has heard a bell she blessed, no matter the distance.

features.name: Sunken Ward
features.text: Takes much less damage while standing in water or rain.

name: The Ledger-Keeper Patron
text: A warlock in debt to a patient power that keeps accounts. It lends power, gold and influence, always with interest.

features.name: Line of Credit
features.text: Can borrow gold from the patron for the town's treasury; it must be repaid with interest or a favour.

features.name: Collect the Debt
features.text: Foes who owe the warlock anything take extra damage from her curses.

features.name: Binding Contract
features.text: Can make a council member keep a promise, but a broken contract summons the patron's collectors.

name: Trailblazer
text: Rangers who cut the roads the caravans will one day use. Every trail they blaze shortens the frontier.

features.name: Blaze Marks
features.text: Marks a safe path through a region so later parties travel it faster.

features.name: Survey the Road
features.text: Can scout a route for a new trade road, revealing ambush points under fog.

features.name: Waystation
features.text: Builds a hidden camp in the wilds where parties can rest safely mid-expedition.

name: Way of the Iron Bell
text: Monks who train beneath the temple bell until their strikes ring like it.

features.name: Ringing Blow
features.text: Unarmed strikes stun weaker foes and interrupt spellcasters.

features.name: Toll the Alarm
features.text: A strike on the town bell alerts every hero in town at once, wherever they are.

features.name: Resonant Body
features.text: Takes less damage from thunder and bludgeoning, and returns part of it as a shockwave.

name: Way of the Lantern
text: Monks who keep the night watch with a single lamp and a still mind. Their light pushes back fog and fear.

features.name: Steady Flame
features.text: Carries a lantern that reveals hidden and invisible foes nearby.

features.name: Watch Without Sleep
features.text: Can stand watch on the walls all night with no loss of rest, and spots night raiders earlier.

features.name: Light the Way
features.text: Once per expedition, burns away fog over a whole region for a short time so the town sees it live.

name: Wayshrine Domain
text: Priests of roads and safe arrivals who bless the caravans and the shrines along the trade roads.

features.name: Road Blessing
features.text: Caravans blessed before leaving are less likely to be ambushed and lose less cargo if they are.

features.name: Raise a Wayshrine
features.text: Can consecrate a shrine on a road; parties passing it heal and the fog around it stays thin.

features.name: Pilgrim's Return
features.text: Once per season, a fallen hero on the road can be carried back by the god to the nearest shrine, alive but exhausted.
